propositions: Write-op input surfaces (force, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) are hand-mirrored across lib, CLI, and MCP adapters without mechanical parity checks, allowing silent drift.

A conformance oracle test suite must execute a shared contract table of (op, inputs, expected outcome) through all three adapters against fresh temp stores and detect any divergence in ACCEPTED/REJECTED/PARAM_NOT_EXPOSED classification.

Current MCP gaps (reason, caused_by, force not exposed on transition_ticket/claim_ticket) are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago; transition coupled-force rows requiring the new force param shape are xfailed citing blusterous-earthly-kitten, keeping the suite green until those tickets land.

Runtime conditional rules (close_class required for bug-close, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) must be asserted behaviorally across all three adapters, rejecting consistently when violated.

The oracle reuses and extends tests/interfaces/adapters.py (Outcome, Adapter protocol, three concrete adapters) to thread force/reason/close_class/caused_by/ref through each transport, with no fresh parallel drivers.
An in-suite convergence check proves the oracle detects when a xfail gap is closed by flipping strict-xfail to xpass, forcing marker removal as the signal.
